create.title: Character-preserving transposed-row energy for the top M2 cone
create.statement_tex: Let H_L be the actual finite odd h-support, let a(h,m) be the exact normalized top-endpoint symbol, and let T_L=sum_(h in H_L) chi_4(h) sum_(ceil(h/4)<=m<=h) a(h,m)e(sqrt(Xhm)). Define R_m=sum_(h in H_L,m<=h<=4m) chi_4(h)a(h,m)e(sqrt(Xhm)). Then T_L=sum_m R_m and |T_L|^2 << L E_L^top, where E_L^top=sum_m|R_m|^2. Its diagonal is O(L^2), and its exact positive-offset part is 2 Re sum_(r>=1)(-1)^r sum_(h,h+2r in H_L) sum_(m=ceil((h+2r)/4))^h a(h,m)conj(a(h+2r,m)) e(-2r sqrt(Xm)/(sqrt(h)+sqrt(h+2r))). Hence E_L^top <<_epsilon L^2 X^epsilon is sufficient for T_L <<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. This finite reduction preserves the ceiling, both affine edges, the actual profile, and chi_4(h)chi_4(h+2r)=(-1)^r.
create.next_action: Prove the complete alternating even-offset union at L^2 X^epsilon before absolute values over the offset; keep the hard moving endpoints and actual symbol.

update.next_action: Prove the exact transposed-row signed energy, equivalently its alternating even-offset aggregate. The frozen leading-wavelet reciprocal energy is not an all-orders identity, and its repaired B-process is an adjoint return.
Prefer the exact transposed-row energy because it preserves chi_4. Retain the characterless interior row correlation only as a stronger sufficient alternative.
Use Cauchy after regrouping by m when treating the top cone: chi_4 remains inside each transposed row and becomes the exact offset sign (-1)^r. Outer h-Cauchy still deletes the character.

Do not iterate the frozen leading-wavelet transform. Any repaired full-symbol transform must be used only as an equivalent representation of the alternating transposed-row energy, unless a genuinely new signed estimate is proved.
For the hard top block attack the exact alternating transposed-row energy. Smooth interior small-gcd packets and the fourth-moment/pointwise interface remain separate.

reject.reason: The angular amplitude is nonconstant. Quadratic stationary phase has a generally nonzero correction g''(t_0)/(8 pi i x l), only J^(-1) below the leading normalized symbol on the narrowest collar; evaluation at t_0 alone cannot have an arbitrary-order remainder.

The symbol square-mass budget controls only the diagonal. An artificial phase-conjugating array satisfies the same size budget while making one S_k of size J, so the actual signed off-diagonal requires additional structure.

The exact discrete square identity is periodized Parseval and contains every integer translate of the narrow l-packets. Replacing it by the unperiodized continuous L2 norm omits the alias off-diagonal.

The active modes are k=-m. The high-character B-process restores the odd character, the cone m<=r<=4m, the phase e(sqrt(Xmr)), and the actual profile, with principal factor e(-1/8)sqrt(J/L). Its energy is the transposed-row Cauchy problem, not an independent gain.

Exact inversion requires the full Fresnel or all-orders moving symbol. The frozen leading symbol loses algebraic stationary corrections, so its finite margin-sensitive self-return is only asymptotic with target-safe error.
The lower and upper collar distances are x(t^2-1/4) and x(1-t^2); they depend on both variables. A fixed angular cutoff does not preserve the affine lattice edges or their derivative ledger.

no_change.reason: The alternating transposed-row energy remains unproved and no polynomial intermediate L-range was added.
Round 75 concerns only the M2 top endpoint.
Both M9-M1 and M9-M2 remain open.
The exact energy reduction gives no full M2 estimate and no global exponent improvement.

round_assessment.reason: The round proves no target estimate, but it corrects a false all-orders transform, independently certifies a character-preserving finite energy reduction, identifies its exact alternating offset, and proves that the reciprocal-energy loop is an adjoint return rather than a new gain.
